'''Tanne Kinalos''' was the partner of [[Kinalos]], a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] soldier. They lived together on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] around the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Together they had at least two sons and a daughter, [[Henia Kinalos|Henia]].<ref name="Author'sCut" />

During the [[Imperial Civil War]] that followed in the aftermath of the [[Second Battle of Coruscant]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], the [[Unidentified residential building (Coruscant)|Kinalos home]] was occupied by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Imperial Stormtroopers]]. Tanne and the rest of the family were forced to flee, leaving many of their possessions behind. They were presumably [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the infighting. Serving with the [[New Republic Army]], [[Kinalos]] later returned to his ruined home, clearing Imperial forces from it before abandoning it for good.<ref name="Author'sCut" />
